release_read.basis: Revenue $1.196bn in line with Zacks $1.19bn, adjusted EPS $0.06 misses $0.10 (Zacks) / $0.09 (Nasdaq) and adj. EBITDA fell 6% q/q on drilling delays and cost inflation; against that a tight frac market with 'continued improvement in service pricing' and a new 1.2 GW data-center power development agreement. Mixed, slight positive tilt from the power narrative, no numeric guide; call at 10:00 ET today decides it.

release.released_at_note: after the close on 2026-10-21 per the company's 10-08 timing release; the 8-K does not state a time of day
release.headline: Liberty Energy Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operational Results

vs_bar.note: Nasdaq brief fallback forecast $0.09 (6 estimates): surprise -33%
no consensus sourced; down 6% q/q from $151m

key_line.detail: Tight frac market, 'continued improvement in service pricing'; new development agreement for 1.2 GW of power services to data-center campuses, 500 MW ESA targeted by Dec 2026; no numeric 2027 capex guide in the release (the line the July print traded on).

guidance.detail: Qualitative only: Q4 weather/holiday seasonality partially offset by strong demand and deferred Q3 work; no numeric Q4 or 2027 guide.

call.detail: Call is 08:00 MT / 10:00 ET today, inside the session. In July the call (capex raise) drove a -22% day; 2027 capex and power funding will be asked. A risk an exit at the open avoids.

public_reaction.summary: Not searched for lack of time (compile at 09:24).

tape_read.note: After-hours traded +8.7% and has sagged to a robust pre-market +3.4% (17 prints, 5 in the last 30 min, last 09:14, not stale), range 16.38-17.75, against a market -0.9%. Still above my +1.0% release read, well inside the 13.6% implied move.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was frac activity up vs a flat revenue bar plus constructive dividend language: revenue only in line, EPS missed, pricing language constructive and the power deal is new upside; the capex question that sank July is unresolved until the call.

expected.open_lag_note: Pre-market is alive (not stale) so the open should hold most of +3.4%, but it is already fading from +8.7% after hours on a weak tape; gaps tend to give back into 10:00 and the call starts exactly at 10:00.

recommendation.reason: De long staat ongeveer 3,5% in de plus, maar de cijfers zijn gemengd (omzet in lijn, winst per aandeel onder verwachting) en de koers zakt al sinds de nabeurs van +8,7% naar +3,4%. Om 10:00 begint de conference call, waar in juli de investeringsplannen een daling van 22% veroorzaakten; dat risico willen we niet dragen. Verkoop op de opening, gelijk aan de standaardregel.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurs voor 09:30 weer duidelijk oploopt richting de nabeurshoogte (boven circa 17,75) op actieve handel, kan een limietverkoop iets hoger overwogen worden.
